title: Normalized integral pullback augmentation equals the ambient operation unit
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, schemes X,Y, and any map g:X→Y. For the completed coefficient module categories of [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists] and [lem-pur-integral-ambient-operation-models], there exists an isomorphism b between their ordinary module pullback functors such that, for every unbounded cochain complex P on Y, the published FrobeniusCoefficientTwists.pullbackAugmentation at P equals the termwise map b_P followed by IntegralAmbient.pullOperationUnit at P. This compares the specified maps, including the zero shifted-product component, without any completeness, flatness or constructibility hypothesis.

source.place: lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules and the arbitrary-map pullback convention; the canonical finite quotient and Roos augmentation normalizations

proof.text: The finite projection equations identify the two completed direct-image ring maps. Apply pushforwardCongr to identify the module right adjoints. Their normalized adjunctions and leftAdjointUniq yield an isomorphism b of left adjoints. The Hom-equivalence/unit equation shows that b takes moduleSection to IntegralAmbient.pullSection on every base-change object.

Compare the augmentations after the first Roos projection and every product projection. The explicit augmentation has the published finite pullback generator as its value on each unit section. The ambient unit first takes the scalar quotient tensor with one, and pullTowerModel then gives precisely that finite generator. The unit equation for b identifies the input sections. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence proves equality of these maps.

The second Roos components are zero: use the chosen augmentation specification and pullOperationUnit_coordinates. The mapping cocone identity writes its identity as the sum of the two projection-inclusion composites. Postcompose the proposed maps with this identity and use the two component equalities to conclude equality in every degree. The argument includes empty schemes and zero complexes.

proof_origin.place: lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules, followed by the existing strict quotient and Roos component normalizations

from.place: Canonical coefficient-line comparison for arbitrary scheme pullback: equality of the normalized ordinary-to-completed augmentation with its ambient completion presentation.

lean.statement:
theorem integralPullbackAugmentation_ambient
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    letI : (show integralTowerModules l E Y ⥤ integralTowerModules l E X from
        FrobeniusCoefficientTwists.modulePull l E g).PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
      @Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive _ _ _ _ _ _
        (show integralTowerModules l E Y ⥤ integralTowerModules l E X from
          FrobeniusCoefficientTwists.modulePull l E g)
        (proEtaleRingModulePullback_additive g
          ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Y)
          ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring X)
          ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull g))
    letI : (IntegralAmbient.pull l E g).PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
      @Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive _ _ _ _ _ _
        (IntegralAmbient.pull l E g) (IntegralAmbient.pull_additive l E g)
    ∃ b : (show integralTowerModules l E Y ⥤ integralTowerModules l E X from
        FrobeniusCoefficientTwists.modulePull l E g) ≅ IntegralAmbient.pull l E g,
      ∀ P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ,
        (FrobeniusCoefficientTwists.pullbackAugmentation l E g).app P =
          ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex b (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) ≫
            IntegralAmbient.pullOperationUnit l E g P
